title: Brake and Steering Control Unit — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Wheels and Brakes — Brake Control Unit

abstract: Removal of the brake and steering control unit from the centre gear bay, with the accumulator pre-load record and the configuration read-out that must be taken before power is removed.

sections.purpose: This task gives the removal of the brake and steering control unit and the associated pressure regulator from the centre gear bay.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be on jacks or chocked with the parking brake released and the brake accumulator discharged to the residual value. The unit configuration part number must be read out and recorded before electrical power is removed, because the installation task has to confirm the same configuration afterwards. Hydraulic spillage protection must be in place under the work position.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE AIRCRAFT IS CHOCKED AND THAT THE BRAKE ACCUMULATOR IS DISCHARGED BEFORE ANY HYDRAULIC CONNECTION IS BROKEN. 2. Apply electrical power and read out the configuration part number reported by the unit. Record it on the work card. 3. Record the pre-load of the accumulator D3240121944667. 4. Remove electrical power and apply the electrical safety precautions. 5. Open the centre gear bay access. 6. CAUTION: CAP EVERY HYDRAULIC CONNECTION AS IT IS BROKEN. AN OPEN LINE ADMITS CONTAMINATION THAT THE FILTER CANNOT REMOVE. 7. Disconnect and cap the hydraulic connections at the unit. 8. Disconnect the electrical connectors and fit the blanking caps. 9. Release the clamp D3240128079286 on the sense line run. 10. Remove the pressure regulator D3240120310957 if it is to be replaced, and support it while the last fastener is removed. 11. Remove the unit from its mounting and put it on the padded trolley. 12. Fit the transit caps to the unit and identify it with the aircraft registration and the removal reason.
sections.close_out: Make sure that every hydraulic connection on the aircraft side is capped and that no fluid is left on the bay floor. Collect the spillage protection material for disposal. Record the removed serial number, the configuration part number and the accumulator pre-load in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Record the configuration part number before power is removed, whatever the reason for the removal.

safety_precautions: Chock the aircraft and release the parking brake.
Discharge the brake accumulator to the residual value.
Put the hydraulic spillage protection in position.
